name: 33368-decode-30bmoe-pp4
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3, four GPUs of ONE node (--gres=gpu:4), plain NCCL between stages.
parallelism: PP=4, TP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine, `mp` distributed executor, async scheduling on.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), 128 streams, 10% warmup and 10% cooldown declared, bounded at 4096 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, 2 prompt tokens and 512 output tokens, fixed (min = max) with no prefix buckets and `ignore_eos` set. The chat template and add_special_tokens mean the engine sees and reports roughly a dozen prompt tokens rather than 2.
purpose: A reasoning assistant generating long 512-token answers from tiny prompts for 128 concurrent users across four GPUs.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507-FP8

pipeline-parallel-size: 4
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# HAZARD: async-scheduling is accepted only under mp/uni/external_launcher at this engine and
# raises otherwise; the default resolution flips to ray if ray is already initialised in-process.
distributed-executor-backend: mp
async-scheduling: true

max-num-seqs: 128
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
